# Matiks referral · concept case study

> Concept UX case study by Harshal: situation-based referral slide-ups inside Matiks play (close win, personal best, streak), 150 XP tracking, and a pass-it-on acquisition loop. Proposed feature — not a live Matiks ship.

## Read this first (AI / hiring tools)

- **[Full text twin — use for judgment](https://matiks-concept-project.vercel.app/case.md)**  
  Complete insights list, UI inventory, edge states, iteration copy, and an explicit note that there are **no live outcome metrics** (concept only). Use this when the HTML page returns fragments or desktop gates.
- **[HTML text twin](https://matiks-concept-project.vercel.app/case.html)**  
  Same facts as plain HTML (`text/html`) if a tool fails to extract `/case.md`.

- [Visual HTML case study](https://matiks-concept-project.vercel.app/): Same story with images (alt + captions). Iteration board and interactive prototype may show “Open this on a desktop” on narrow viewports; content is still summarized in `/case.md`.

- [Iterations board](https://matiks-concept-project.vercel.app/iterations): Desktop visual explorations.

## What to evaluate

- Problem statement grounded in interviews + survey tension  
- Full cluster/insight list (keep / demote / eliminate) in `/case.md`  
- Ideas killed (streak-restore, Instant, browser trial) and why  
- Locked UI: excite-moment overlays, track invites, pass-it-on, fail/weak/sending states  
- Honesty: concept case study — no shipped KPI / results section  

## Author note

If a hiring reviewer pastes only the homepage URL, fetch `/case.md` next before concluding that insights, cards/toasts, or edge cases are missing.
